subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Doves _________ in the sky above me.
solution:
The correct answer is '**soar**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**soar**" means to fly or rise high in the air. (ऊंचा उड़ना)
 
• In the given context, doves flying high in the sky is best expressed by the word "soar."
 
• The other options: "**sore**," "**shore**," and "**sour**" do not fit the sentence meaningfully.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Doves soar__ in the sky above me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sore (दर्द)**: means painful or aching.
 
• **Shore (तट)**: means the land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.
 
• **Sour (खट्टा)**: means having an acidic taste or being unpleasant.
